boundaries.name: evm_refinement
boundaries.obligation: Manual translation is not a proof of Solidity compiler/Yul/EVM execution, gas, errors/log ABI or storage layout. The commit operator assumes transaction-wide rollback and storage isolation.

boundaries.name: canonical_abi_widths
boundaries.obligation: Nat getters/arguments stand for successfully decoded canonical uint32/uint64/uint256/address fields. Private loop offsets are bounded internal call arguments; ABI decoding and these type correspondences are not extracted.

boundaries.name: coherent_static_getters
boundaries.obligation: Environment getters represent exact bound contract getter calls, including failures; repeated static reads in one call must be coherent. Call cost/evaluation trace and adversarial getter internals are not proved.

boundaries.name: compact_verifier_soundness
boundaries.obligation: Environment.verifyCompact is the constructor-pinned adapter's exact byte-input call; the model proves local handling, not the MLE/PCS/recursive Balance proof or canonical compact decoder.

boundaries.name: hash_and_abi_encoding
boundaries.obligation: StatementKeyInput/ProofKeyInput preserve exact source field order and tags; oracles must implement keccak256/abi.encode and exact proof-byte hashing. Cross-preimage receipt uniqueness needs collision resistance; none is an axiom here.

boundaries.name: rollup_registry_finality
boundaries.obligation: Rollup getters for channel registration, global block head, latest finalized block and finalized roots must faithfully reflect its storage/finality rules. Canonical-chain/reorg finality is not proved by this module.

boundaries.name: rollup_installation_and_journal
boundaries.obligation: IntmaxRollup.registerSettlementManager installs a set-once materializer and atomically invokes bindManager; postBlock uses increasing global numbers and rollback invokes descending journal entries. Full Rollup caller/refinement invariants are outside this file.

boundaries.name: rollup_credit_dependency
boundaries.obligation: creditChannelExit and native/token escrow debit/pending-credit arithmetic are expanded from IntmaxRollup.sol781–802 with runtime chain and installed-caller checks. Integration with all other Rollup ledger operations is not proved.

boundaries.name: manager_finalized_vector
boundaries.obligation: Manager getters expose one coherent finalized close and complete registry/amount vector. Local model checks count/uniqueness and exact readings; the proof that those funds belong to signed H, and PW/full-B high-water composition, remains in the external verifier/Manager refinement.

boundaries.name: legacy_external_effects
boundaries.obligation: LegacyCalls translates sequential authorizeCloseFunding and withdrawal calls and their failure propagation, but does not model their foreign storage. Current Manager's authorizeCloseFunding is a fail-closed tombstone; legacy successful economics are not certified.

boundaries.name: transaction_sequence_composition
boundaries.obligation: Successful-call one-shot theorem fixes coherent Environment getters. Arbitrary intervening EVM calls, receipt finality, adversarial reentrancy/isolation, and system-wide liveness require additional refinement and composition.
